name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.80 / build 81 updates the SMAPE/MAPE submission and review workflow. Patients no longer enter vital signs; authorized clinic personnel manage these measurements. Adds Medical Records History for the signed-in patient's released clinical results; draft records remain private. Existing forms, saved records and support conversations are preserved. Requires the matching clinical-records backend and private database rules. Existing development/test signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Physical-phone installation and actual patient push delivery were not verified.
